extraction.name_resolution: Local OPSIN via pyopsin==0.2.4; deep name analysis on
extraction.method: Verbatim typed requests from dp5_artifacts/compound_N/assessment.json, cross-checked against results.json and original DOCX names and observations in document order. Original SMILES atom order, carbon groups, observations, capacities and IDs are retained. source_paragraph_1based is the parser source index; docx_paragraph_1based locates the original python-docx observation paragraph.
extraction.limits: Requests are regression inputs from the actual DOCX names, not adjudicated scientific truth. 3.9 revised and 3.10 original differ from historical SDF SMILES; do not substitute that manifest.
